seo.title: Artists’ Gallery
seo.description: Explore visual art from the creative community at Temple Aviv Judea.

hero.title: Faith in full color.
hero.intro: Visual art is one of the ways our community reflects on Scripture, Jewish identity, worship, and the unfolding story of G-d’s people.

gallery.imageAlt: Colorful congregational artwork of two women with jewelry and a garment bearing Hebrew text
gallery.caption: Beauty, identity, and the generations of Israel.

gallery.imageAlt: Colorful congregational artwork depicting Moses holding the tablets
gallery.caption: Torah, revelation, and the faithfulness of G-d.

callToAction.heading: Bring your imagination into worship.
callToAction.body: Ask about visual art, music, drama, and dance at Temple Aviv Judea.
